correctness.rationale: Exact eigenbasis accounts for all 2p+q eigenvalues; spectral norm convexity justifies automorphism averaging of unrestricted feasible matrices. At each fixed Y the minimized maximum over X is (1-Y)/3, yielding an elementary three-affine-function envelope on a closed interval. Checking the four exact minimizers and equality inequalities gives all invariant optima. Exact rational replay covered 453 stochastic matrices and 151 independently vertex-enumerated linear programs; arbitrary sizes depend on the proof.

value.rationale: Fully parameterizes fastest-mixing design on the natural two-equal-part unequal tripartite infinite family with three exact thresholds and a nontrivial interval of globally optimal invariant allocations. The criterion identifies which cross-class edge orbit may be dropped and when self-loops disappear; these reflect actual changes in network design and are not isolated toy numerics.
